title: August and the Static
author: V. M. Vasquez
blurb: Dominic Oyelaran, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
